name: hvac-portable-auth-mount-contents
instr:
Let operators migrate portable contents between Vault authentication mounts without method-specific scripts or transporting unavailable secrets. The workflow must be deterministic, inspectable, safe to preview, and resumable after partial failure while preserving existing endpoint behavior.

Across AppRole, AWS, Azure, GCP, JWT, Kubernetes, LDAP, and Userpass, portable discovery, export, application, and supported removal preserve stable identities, writable values, mount translation, native operation semantics, and explicit portability limits; unsupported operations raise `PortableAuthError` before requests. `AuthMethods.migration(self, method, destination, source_mount, destination_mount)` selects its owned endpoints and rejects unsupported or incompatible methods before discovery. Planning deterministically resolves conflicts under `ConflictPolicy`, blocks unsafe objects and dependents, and orders prerequisites before stable peers. Dry runs report every predicted outcome without mutation or checkpointing. Execution checkpoints each outcome before continuing; failures raise `MigrationExecutionError` with `report` and `cause`, preserve completed work, and leave the remaining suffix pending. `resume(self, plan, store)` continues only compatible pending work, returns completed reports without endpoint calls, and raises `MigrationStateError` carrying `plan_id` for mismatches. `MigrationStore.load(self, plan_id)`, `MigrationStore.save(self, report)`, `MemoryMigrationStore.load(s
